channel.title: Isle of Wight Radio - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Isle of Wight Radio (iwradio.co.uk)

item.title: Yarmouth Businesses Shine In Festive Window Competition
item.description: The annual competition, organised by the Yarmouth Traders Retail Collective and led by Adrian Evans, added extra magic to the town’s seasonal celebrations.

item.title: Take The Plunge: Boxing Day And New Year’s Dips Set To Take Place Across The Island
item.description: If you’re feeling brave this Christmas, there are plenty of opportunities to take a chilly dip in the sea across festive season!

item.title: Hot Summer Sees Fire Incidents Rise By More Than A Third Across Hampshire And Isle Of Wight
item.description: Between April and September 2025, fire incidents increased by around 36% compared to the same period the previous year.

item.title: Emergency Services Resolve Welfare Incident On Ryde Seafront
item.description: Emergency services were called to Ryde seafront at lunchtime on Boxing Day following concerns for the welfare of an individual near Ryde Pier.

item.title: Not On The Menu: Council Rejects Sam’s Chicken Sign
item.description: County Hall rejected Mr T. Pirapagaran’s proposed illuminated advertising which is already in place at Sam’s Chicken on Newport’s St James’ Street.

item.title: Shanklin Shop Owner Speaks Out Over Plans To Convert Premises Into Flat
item.description: An Isle of Wight fibre artist has spoken out after plans were submitted to convert the shop premises she currently uses into a residential flat.

item.title: Island Dance Academy Performs on Iconic West End Stage
item.description: It was a memorable day for Creationz Dance Academy as 13 young dancers from the Isle of Wight took to the stage at London’s iconic Shaftesbury Theatre.

item.title: Stray Dog Policy, Coroner’s Service Recovery Plan And Domestic Abuse Strategy Backed By Isle Of Wight Council
item.description: Stray Dog Policy, Coroner’s Service Recovery Plan and Domestic Abuse Strategy Backed by Isle of Wight Council.

item.title: Animals Sadly Die In Ryde Flat Fire
item.description: A suspected electrical fault is believed to have caused a fire at a flat in central Ryde on Monday evening, tragically resulting in the deaths of animals inside the property.

item.title: Mainland Police Specialists Called In After Cyclist Seriously Injured In Newport
item.description: Specialist police officers are carrying out a forensic investigation in Newport after a cyclist was found with serious injuries, leading to them being airlifted to a major trauma unit.
